errors.evidence: The reference description explains that blue bars represent values below 9% and red bars represent values above 10%, but the machine-generated description states there is no legend explaining the colors.
The machine-generated description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart, which is to show the most significant measures to limit the 'hidden economy' in the country.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the horizontal axis represents percentage values, as noted in the reference.
The machine-generated description does not mention the color coding of the bars (blue for values below 9% and red for values above 10%), which is explicitly described in the reference.

The machine-generated description does not highlight that the longest bars correspond to 'Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система,' 'Да се намали корупцията,' and 'Да се подобри качеството на административните услуги,' as noted in the reference.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the shortest bars correspond to 'Да се засили граничния контрол' and 'Да се намалят акцизите,' as noted in the reference.
